## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request targets `dev`
- [ ] `npm run check` passes, and `dist/` is rebuilt and committed
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] If the card looks different: `npm run example` is rerun, and a screenshot is attached
- [ ] If an option changed: the README and `examples/oss-card.yml` are updated
